patch_description: Add a bounded compound neighborhood to the existing relocation and swap search: exchange one model on one GPU for two models on another GPU. This can improve the maximum KVPR when neither a single feasible move nor a one-for-one swap is sufficient, especially when memory fragmentation prevents direct balancing. The action is evaluated only after ordinary moves and swaps find no improvement, preserving their lower-cost search behavior and requiring a strictly improved feasible score.
